title: Hugging Face Transformers
summary: Hugging Face Transformers is a state-of-the-art library providing pre-trained models for various modalities like text, vision, and audio. It offers a unified API to easily download, fine-tune, and deploy models for tasks such as text generation, image classification, and speech recognition. The library empowers developers and researchers to build and experiment with advanced AI applications efficiently.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: Interacts with the library to leverage pre-trained models, fine-tune them, or deploy AI applications.

nodes.label: High-Level Tasks & Generation
nodes.title: Pipelines & Generation Module
nodes.description: Provides user-friendly, task-specific pipelines for common ML tasks and the core logic for text generation, simplifying model inference and creative text output.

nodes.label: Model Architectures & Utilities
nodes.title: Model Architectures Module
nodes.description: Defines the vast collection of pre-trained model architectures for NLP, computer vision, and audio, along with utilities for model conversion and management.

nodes.label: Data Preprocessing
nodes.title: Data Processing Module
nodes.description: Handles the preparation of raw data (text, images, audio) into model-compatible formats, including tokenization, feature extraction, and image transformations.

nodes.label: Model Optimization & Deployment
nodes.title: Quantization & Integrations Module
nodes.description: Offers tools for optimizing model size and speed through quantization, integrates with external ML tools for experiment tracking and fine-tuning, and provides CLI for model serving.

groups.label: User & Application Layer
groups.title: User Interaction & High-Level Tasks
groups.description: This layer represents how users interact with the library, primarily through high-level pipelines for common machine learning tasks and direct generation capabilities.

groups.label: Core ML Foundation
groups.title: Core Machine Learning Components
groups.description: This group encompasses the fundamental building blocks of the library: the diverse model architectures and the essential data preprocessing utilities.

groups.label: Model Lifecycle Management
groups.title: Optimization, Integration & Deployment
groups.description: Focuses on optimizing models for efficiency, integrating with external MLOps tools, and providing mechanisms for serving models in production environments.
